programme.title: The Story of Flying Trident
programme.desc: Feicha, or a flying trident, is a type of performance where you balance a revolving trident on your body. In Chinese history, the trident was one of the 18 main weapons of war, but now it has become more of an acrobatic act. For thousands of years, people in China have practiced it as a performance and also as a way to keep fit. It seems like the trident is stuck to the person’s body like a magnet, but that effect is achieved by tensing and relaxing muscles at the right time so that the movement of the trident is channeled in the right direction—be it around the hands, neck, or back. Otherwise, its energy will turn against the performer.

programme.title: Foodwise: The Herbal Way of Life
programme.desc: 'Medicine tonic is not as good as food tonic' - this Chinese saying is a core principle of Traditional Chinese Medicine. It is believed that the right diet and nourishment can cure and reverse the effects of disease, hence considered an inevitable source of natural health preservation. In this Foodwise episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May explore this ancient concept of medicine food homology as they taste their way through different herbs, chat to experts of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) and visit venues that combine conventional principles with modern ideas. Dive deep into the origin of TCM with us as we learn about the harmony between man and nature and its application in modern functional foods!

programme.title: Foodwise: The Taste of Home
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May eat their way down memory lane across virtual space and different time zones, and embark on a culinary journey at their birthplace. Eva rediscovers her love for a classic century-old dish in her hometown Vienna and introduces Austria's long-lasting coffeehouse culture to Tianran, who also joins her virtually for an evening with friends and food the traditional Viennese way. Meanwhile, Beijing's charming autumn season sets Tianran back in time as he rediscovers flavors from his childhood. His passion for tea might have even started in one of the old tea shops in Beijing's hutongs, recollecting his memories one sip at a time, accompanied by nostalgic meals and a relaxed stroll under yellow gingko trees.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoxing
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in the historic water town of Shaoxing, famed for its yellow wine. Traversing its canals by boat, Tianran discovers why it's said there are 10,000 bridges in Shaoxing, before enjoying the freshest catch of the day. But as it turns out, Shaoxing's climate is also perfect for fermentation, leading to a wide array of unique local foods that can sometimes be both smelly and delicious – and at other times, downright unforgettable!

His passion for tea might have even started in one of the old tea shops in Beijing's hutongs, recollecting his memories one sip at a time, accompanied by nostalgic meals and a relaxed stroll under yellow gingko trees.

programme.title: Miao Embroidery: History in Stitches
programme.desc: According to legend, during a migration by the Miao ethnic group, a female chieftain wanted to keep a record of all the mountains and lakes she passed along the way. The means she chose of doing so was by stitching the images on her dress. By the time they reached a suitable place to settle, her clothing was covered with embroidered designs. This, it’s said, was the origin of Miao embroidery. As the story tells us, the designs in Miao embroidery are closely related to the natural world and daily life. The Miao people have a special fondness for nature. So, as well as depicting their daily farming and work activities, they copy birds, flowers, mountains, and grass onto their clothing. Over the years, the embroidery of the Miao people has become a written record of their life. The stitches are like characters which, when many of them are combined, become a record of their history, their collected wisdom, and the knowledge passed down from their ancestors.

programme.title: The Story of Flying Trident
programme.desc: Feicha, or a flying trident, is a type of performance where you balance a revolving trident on your body. In Chinese history, the trident was one of the 18 main weapons of war, but now it has become more of an acrobatic act. For thousands of years, people in China have practiced it as a performance and also as a way to keep fit. It seems like the trident is stuck to the person’s body like a magnet, but that effect is achieved by tensing and relaxing muscles at the right time so that the movement of the trident is channeled in the right direction—be it around the hands, neck, or back. Otherwise, its energy will turn against the performer.

programme.title: Huayin Old Tunes: the Earliest Rock and Roll by the Yellow River
programme.desc: Huayin Laoqiang is the name given to a traditional form of shadow puppet show. It translates as “Huayin Old Tunes,” and originated in the chanting of the boatmen working at the confluence of the Yellow, Weihe, and Luohe Rivers, close to the city of Huayin in Shaanxi Province. This chanting evolved into folk songs which, with time, were illustrated with puppet shows. The loud music, rustic instruments, and enthusiastic performances epitomize the way the local people lead their lives.

programme.title: Grand Song of the Dong — Natural Oriental Harmony
programme.desc: The Grand Song of the Dong is a polyphonic folk singing tradition of the Dong ethnic group. Performers from several villages gather together to sing, unaccompanied. The songs, which describe the history, beliefs, customs, and emotions of the Dong people, are an important part of their cultural identity and contribute significantly to their social cohesion. Generally sung in the Dong language, which has no written form, they are passed on orally from one generation to the next. Classified into various genres—including narrative and love songs, drinking and funeral songs—they are often accompanied by clapping, stomping, and dancing. Sung on occasions such as festivals, weddings, and funerals, the Grand Song, as a valuable part of the Dong ethnic group’s cultural heritage, reflects their wisdom and creativity, as well as their harmony with nature.

programme.title: Four Faces of Muqam
programme.desc: Muqam is a performing art with its roots in the folklore of Xinjiang. Rather like an encyclopedia, Muqam is a record of the history and lifestyle of the local Uygur people. It originated in folk culture, with lyrics that covered everything from philosophical aphorisms to folk tales. Muqam is a vehicle for Uygur people to express their feelings and ideas. As such, it is an integral part of Xinjiang culture—and even the culture of the Silk Road. In the episode, the host travels around the Kashgar area, learning about the history and art of Muqam.

The loud music, rustic instruments, and enthusiastic performances epitomize the way the local people lead their lives.

programme.title: Grand Song of the Dong — Natural Oriental Harmony
programme.desc: The Grand Song of the Dong is a polyphonic folk singing tradition of the Dong ethnic group. Performers from several villages gather together to sing, unaccompanied. The songs, which describe the history, beliefs, customs, and emotions of the Dong people, are an important part of their cultural identity and contribute significantly to their social cohesion. Generally sung in the Dong language, which has no written form, they are passed on orally from one generation to the next. Classified into various genres—including narrative and love songs, drinking and funeral songs—they are often accompanied by clapping, stomping, and dancing. Sung on occasions such as festivals, weddings, and funerals, the Grand Song, as a valuable part of the Dong ethnic group’s cultural heritage, reflects their wisdom and creativity, as well as their harmony with nature.

programme.desc: Muqam is a performing art with its roots in the folklore of Xinjiang. Rather like an encyclopedia, Muqam is a record of the history and lifestyle of the local Uygur people. It originated in folk culture, with lyrics that covered everything from philosophical aphorisms to folk tales. Muqam is a vehicle for Uygur people to express their feelings and ideas. As such, it is an integral part of Xinjiang culture—and even the culture of the Silk Road. In the episode, the host travels around the Kashgar area, learning about the history and art of Muqam.

programme.desc: The stunning east coast of Hainan in southeast China, attract numerous visitors to travel. The reason that people tend to visit Hianan not only because of the beautiful beach view but also delicious local cuisine in Hainan. Hainan’s four famous dishes is Chicken, duck, goat and crab. In Wenchang, the ancestral home of many overseas Chinese, people could discover the original version of Hainan Chicken Rice and see how local chickens free range on coconut meat. In Qionghai, seat of the Boao Forum for Asia, you may dine on duck and goat, before feasting on crab in the surfer haven of Wanning.

programme.title: Huayin Old Tunes: the Earliest Rock and Roll by the Yellow River
programme.desc: Huayin Laoqiang is the name given to a traditional form of shadow puppet show. It translates as “Huayin Old Tunes,” and originated in the chanting of the boatmen working at the confluence of the Yellow, Weihe, and Luohe Rivers, close to the city of Huayin in Shaanxi Province. This chanting evolved into folk songs which, with time, were illustrated with puppet shows. The loud music, rustic instruments, and enthusiastic performances epitomize the way the local people lead their lives.

programme.title: Grand Song of the Dong — Natural Oriental Harmony
programme.desc: The Grand Song of the Dong is a polyphonic folk singing tradition of the Dong ethnic group. Performers from several villages gather together to sing, unaccompanied. The songs, which describe the history, beliefs, customs, and emotions of the Dong people, are an important part of their cultural identity and contribute significantly to their social cohesion. Generally sung in the Dong language, which has no written form, they are passed on orally from one generation to the next. Classified into various genres—including narrative and love songs, drinking and funeral songs—they are often accompanied by clapping, stomping, and dancing. Sung on occasions such as festivals, weddings, and funerals, the Grand Song, as a valuable part of the Dong ethnic group’s cultural heritage, reflects their wisdom and creativity, as well as their harmony with nature.

programme.title: Four Faces of Muqam
programme.desc: Muqam is a performing art with its roots in the folklore of Xinjiang. Rather like an encyclopedia, Muqam is a record of the history and lifestyle of the local Uygur people. It originated in folk culture, with lyrics that covered everything from philosophical aphorisms to folk tales. Muqam is a vehicle for Uygur people to express their feelings and ideas. As such, it is an integral part of Xinjiang culture—and even the culture of the Silk Road. In the episode, the host travels around the Kashgar area, learning about the history and art of Muqam.

programme.title: Ningxia: Echoes of the Yellow River
programme.desc: Ningxia: Echoes of the Yellow River is a documentary focusing on the World Heritage sites and cultural–ecological conservation in the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region. Through the lens of Ningxia’s heritage stories, the film highlights China’s commitment to World Heritage preservation, ecological restoration, and cultural continuity — presenting to global audiences a land where history and modernity intertwine, and where desert and oasis coexist. By following the guardians of the Western Xia Imperial Tombs, desert restorers in the Tengger Desert, Great Wall rangers at Sanguankou, traditional sheepskin raft craftsmen, and managers of the Yellow River irrigation system in Qingtongxia, the program reveals Ningxia’s distinctive contributions to cultural heritage, natural ecology, and intangible traditions — and the enduring human spirit behind them.

programme.title: A Sip of Mount Wuyi
programme.desc: Wuyi rock tea, nurtured in the mineral-rich cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains, is a distinctive oolong embodying a unique "rock rhyme" (yan yun)—a taste of nature's harmony. More than a beverage, teas like Da Hong Pao invite mindful appreciation, reflecting centuries of tradition and a philosophy of patience in their complex roasted notes and enduring aftertaste. Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

programme.title: The sound of casting
programme.desc: For centuries, the fires of craftsmanship have never faded in Pingyao. In this UNESCO World Heritage city once famed for trade, three ancient metalworking traditions — sword casting, gold and silver crafting, and iron forging — continue to thrive. This episode steps into the workshops where artisans shape metal with fire and devotion. Each blade’s edge, each ornament’s gleam, and each curve of wrought iron tells a story of resilience and artistry — revealing how the spirit of Pingyao’s craftsmanship still glows in the heart of time.

Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

programme.title: The sound of casting
programme.desc: For centuries, the fires of craftsmanship have never faded in Pingyao. In this UNESCO World Heritage city once famed for trade, three ancient metalworking traditions — sword casting, gold and silver crafting, and iron forging — continue to thrive. This episode steps into the workshops where artisans shape metal with fire and devotion. Each blade’s edge, each ornament’s gleam, and each curve of wrought iron tells a story of resilience and artistry — revealing how the spirit of Pingyao’s craftsmanship still glows in the heart of time.

programme.title: Yangliuqing New Year Painting Art
programme.desc: On May 20, 2006, Yangliuqing New Year Paintings were named as part of China’s national intangible cultural heritage. The New Year painting tradition can be traced back many centuries, to the Ming Dynasty and beyond, reaching the height of its popularity in the Qing Dynasty. There are no restrictions on the themes of the paintings, and there is no blessing they cannot convey. Yangliuqing New Year Paintings are loved all over the country for their beautiful details and vivid colors—but most of all, for the good wishes they impart to anyone who sees them.

programme.title: Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe
programme.desc: On the occasion of the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between China and the EU, Inheritors of China launches a special multimedia series titled “Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe.” Taking culture as the starting point, the series responds to public discourse by telling the real-life stories of Europeans living in China. Through their perspectives, it vividly illustrates how tradition and modernity spark mutual inspiration between China and Europe—showcasing a relationship of shared growth, empowerment, and enduring partnership. The series travels through cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Jinan, and Datong, focusing on Europeans of different ages and professions—from programming and installation art to music, calligraphy, and martial arts. Their lived experiences offer fresh insight into how cultural exchange between China and Europe continues to gain vitality, and how mutual learning between civilizations breathes lasting life into practical cooperation.

programme.title: Fujian’s Tulou – The Mysterious Earthen Castles
programme.desc: The tulous, or earth-built dwellings, of Fujian are recognized as treasures of traditional architecture, thanks to their unique design, cultural importance, and embodiment of the concept of harmonious coexistence with nature. Tulous are mostly rectangular or circular in form, with a simple, elegant exterior and a well-furnished interior. As homes built by the Hakka people, they are imbued with diligence, wisdom, and the pursuit of excellence. Surrounded by mountains and waters, the tulous blend well with the natural environment. When building their tulous, the Hakka people pay attention to ecological balance in order to minimize their environmental footprint. A tulou is not only a safe place to live, but also the crystallization of the culture and architectural skill passed down for generations among the Hakka people.

programme.desc: The tulous, or earth-built dwellings, of Fujian are recognized as treasures of traditional architecture, thanks to their unique design, cultural importance, and embodiment of the concept of harmonious coexistence with nature. Tulous are mostly rectangular or circular in form, with a simple, elegant exterior and a well-furnished interior. As homes built by the Hakka people, they are imbued with diligence, wisdom, and the pursuit of excellence. Surrounded by mountains and waters, the tulous blend well with the natural environment. When building their tulous, the Hakka people pay attention to ecological balance in order to minimize their environmental footprint. A tulou is not only a safe place to live, but also the crystallization of the culture and architectural skill passed down for generations among the Hakka people.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoguan
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in the picturesque city of Shaoguan in Guangdong Province, South China. They try tea grown on Danxia landforms and feast on mountain produce, before getting hands-on with making rice noodles in a Hakka walled village. They learn about the Hakka people’s southward migration and the effect it had on local tea and food, and end their journey in a thousand-year-old Buddhist temple, seeing how the monks integrate their practice into everyday life, and discovering just why tea is so important to Zen.

programme.title: Yangliuqing New Year Painting Art
programme.desc: On May 20, 2006, Yangliuqing New Year Paintings were named as part of China’s national intangible cultural heritage. The New Year painting tradition can be traced back many centuries, to the Ming Dynasty and beyond, reaching the height of its popularity in the Qing Dynasty. There are no restrictions on the themes of the paintings, and there is no blessing they cannot convey. Yangliuqing New Year Paintings are loved all over the country for their beautiful details and vivid colors—but most of all, for the good wishes they impart to anyone who sees them.

programme.title: Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe
programme.desc: On the occasion of the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between China and the EU, Inheritors of China launches a special multimedia series titled “Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe.” Taking culture as the starting point, the series responds to public discourse by telling the real-life stories of Europeans living in China. Through their perspectives, it vividly illustrates how tradition and modernity spark mutual inspiration between China and Europe—showcasing a relationship of shared growth, empowerment, and enduring partnership. The series travels through cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Jinan, and Datong, focusing on Europeans of different ages and professions—from programming and installation art to music, calligraphy, and martial arts. Their lived experiences offer fresh insight into how cultural exchange between China and Europe continues to gain vitality, and how mutual learning between civilizations breathes lasting life into practical cooperation.

programme.title: Fujian’s Tulou – The Mysterious Earthen Castles
programme.desc: The tulous, or earth-built dwellings, of Fujian are recognized as treasures of traditional architecture, thanks to their unique design, cultural importance, and embodiment of the concept of harmonious coexistence with nature. Tulous are mostly rectangular or circular in form, with a simple, elegant exterior and a well-furnished interior. As homes built by the Hakka people, they are imbued with diligence, wisdom, and the pursuit of excellence. Surrounded by mountains and waters, the tulous blend well with the natural environment. When building their tulous, the Hakka people pay attention to ecological balance in order to minimize their environmental footprint. A tulou is not only a safe place to live, but also the crystallization of the culture and architectural skill passed down for generations among the Hakka people.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.1

Then, he tries his hand at Tibetan papermaking, learning how a poisonous ingredient is crucial for making paper that can survive for centuries. Finally, Tianran dons his apron and learns to make iconic Tibetan dishes, including one said to reveal your fortune!

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.2

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.3
programme.desc: Join Tianran He on a high-speed train to Shigatse, gateway to the Himalayas and home to Mount Qomolangma, the world’s highest peak. Here, Tianran samples breakfast at a bustling local teahouse and experiences monastic life at the vast Tashilunpo Monastery. He then visits an agricultural park where tropical crops thrive against the odds of the alpine plateau, before discovering pulu — a traditional Tibetan textile now earning global acclaim.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He travels to Shannan, the cradle of Tibetan culture. Nestled in the gentlest valley of the Yarlung Zangbo River, this is where the first Tibetan king rose to power, the first palace in Xizang was built, and many other “firsts” in Xizang’s history began. Tianran visits Yamdrok Lake, one of Xizang’s three sacred lakes, where a paragliding base is taking shape. He then learns the art of Tibetan opera, joins rangers on a mission to track the elusive Tibetan red deer, and ends the day with a rejuvenating soak in a village revitalized by hot spring tourism.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.5

Her marriage into the Sengupta family sets in motion a series of revelations.

programme.title: تو جوليت جات دي - Tuu Juliet Jatt Di
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح84 : ‫تلتقي الفتاة الطموحة هير بالشاب المميز نواب، مما يشعل شرارة لقصة حب غير متوقعة. في خضم تحديات رحلتهما، تتكتشف حكاية حب متشابكة تنطوي على الخداع والاضطراب العاطفي.‬‬ S1 , E84 : Focused Heer encounters privileged Nawab, sparking an unexpected romance. Their journey unfolds amidst challenges, revealing a tale of love intertwined with deception and emotional turmoil.

programme.title: مانت هار كوشي باني كي - Mannat Harr Khushi Paane Ki
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح336 : ‫تحلم مانات وهي طاهية شابة موهوبة أحلاما كبيرة، لكنها تواجه عقبة كأداء وهي صاحبة عملها القاسية آيشواريا. تكون آيشواريا هي أيضا والدة مانات الحقيقية التي تخلت عنها عند ولادتها دون علمهما.‬‬ S1 , E336 : Mannat, a gifted young chef, dreams big but faces a formidable obstacle, her ruthless employer Aishwarya. Unknown to both, Aishwarya is also Mannat's birth mother who abandoned her when she was born.

programme.title: دكتور أرامبي - DR. Aarambhi
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح9 : ‫تتمسك أرامبي التي تفوقت في امتحان القبول الطبي الهندي سابقا بحلم خفي منتظرة الشرارة التي تشعل بقية حياتها، إلا أن الزواج يقف عقبة في طريقها.‬‬ S1 , E9 : Vishwas stuns Avantika by suggesting that Aarambhi's death is the key to winning his custody battle. He then maps out a lethal plan to marry Avantika by getting his wife out of the way.

programme.title: مانغال لاكشمي - Mangal Lakshmi

فينيس وفيرب - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
القطار السريع/ "سندس" جن جنونها
يستفيد "فارس" و"فادي" من يوم الصيف استفادة تامة من خلال تشييد ألطف قطار سريع على الإطلاق في الفناء الخلفي لمنزلهم/ في عيد ميلاد "سندس"، تقوم العائلة برحلة إلى جبل راشمور حيث ينظم "فارس" و"فادي" مفاجأة مذهلة "لسندس". Rollercoaster/ Candace Loses Her Head
Phineas and Ferb take full advantage of the summer day by building the coolest rollercoaster ever in their backyard. /On Candace’s birthday, the family takes a trip to Mount Rushmore where Phineas and Ferb orchestrate an amazing surprise for Candace.

programme.title: مدينة الجرينز الكبيرة - Big City Greens: Season 2
programme.desc:
(غرين) في المرآة / تذاكر (كريكت)
حين يزور عائلة (غرين) شركة (بيغ تك)، تكتشف (تيلي) فرصة لتحسين عائلتها الفوضوية. يربح (كريكت) تذكرتين لحضور عرض مسرحي، ويجب أن يختار من سيرافقه، (تيلي) أم (ريمي)؟ Green Mirror/ Cricket's Tickets
When the Greens visit BigTech, Tilly discovers a chance to improve her chaotic family. Cricket wins tickets to a show and must decide whether to bring Tilly or Remy.

programme.title: مدينة الجرينز الكبيرة - Big City Greens: Season 2
programme.desc:
ميدان تايمز سيركل/الجدة الرائعة
تيلي وريمي يقدمان مسرحية بينما يلتقي كريكت بأبطاله المفضلين حين تفقد الجدة بصرها مؤقتًا، يحاول كريكت وتيلي مساعدتها Times Circle/ Super Gramma
Tilly and Remy put on a play while Cricket meets his favorite superheroes! When Gramma temporarily loses her eyesight, Cricket and Tilly try to help her.

programme.title: مدينة الجرينز الكبيرة - Big City Greens: Season 2
programme.desc:
توتر الهدية/دراجة مؤذية
يعاني كريكت لإحضار أفضل هدية عيد ميلاد لأعز أصدقائه ريمي بعد حادث وشيك بالدراجة الترابية، الخوف يدفع كريكت لقرار أن يعيش حياته مختبئًا Present Tense/ Hurt Bike
Cricket struggles to get the best birthday present for his best bud, Remy. Due to a close call with a dirt bike, Cricket fearfully decides to live his life in shelter.

programme.title: "هامستر" و"غريتل" - Hamster & Gretel
programme.desc:
وقت الصمت / كنت عالماً مراهقاً مهووساً
تؤدي "غريتل" مشروعاً مدرسياً عن نفسها بينما يوقف "كيفن" و"هامستر" امينة مكتبة شريرة، ويحضر البروفيسور "إكسلاميشن" حفل لم شمل مدرسته الثانوية. Shush Hour / I Was a Teenage Mad Scientist
Gretel does a school project on herself while Kevin and Hamster stop a librarian villain; Professor Exclamation attends his high school reunion.

programme.title: "هامستر" و"غريتل" - Hamster & Gretel
programme.desc:
مجرمات عديدات/الرئيسة فريد
تواجه "غريتل" شريراً يمكنه مضاعفة نفسه، ويترشح "فريد" لرئاسة مجلس الطلاب. Too Many Crooks / President Fred
Gretel encounters a villain who can multiply herself; Fred runs for student body president.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
الهروب من برج "فارس" / بقايا خلد الماء
يقرر "فادي" و"فارس" صنع برج يتحكم فيه حاسوب والذي سيحاصرهما في الداخل، ويجعلهما يكتشفان عالم الهروب. إنهما يحظيان بالمتعة حتى يصبح الحاسوب عاقلًا ويخرج عن السيطرة. في هذه الأثناء "أبو الأشرار" يخترع جهاز الوقاحة لإفساد مقابلة "روجر" مع شخصية مرموقة من "إنكلترا". / يعم الجنون بلدة "دانفيل" ولا أحد يدري ماذا يحدث. تحدث السخافة حينما "فارس" و"فادي" يخترعان جهازًا جديدًا. يجعل "أبو الأشرار" من "بيري" كبير الخدم باستخدام جهاز كبير الخدم، و"كارل" يصبح محبوسًا في زيّ السنجاب. Escape from Phineas Tower/The Remains of the Platypus
When Phineas and Ferb are inspired by an antique escape chamber Dad acquires, they decide to build a computer-controlled tower that will trap them inside and allow them to explore the world of escapement. They have fun breaking out of all the traps until the tower becomes self-aware and goes beyond what it was programmed to do. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz invents a "rude-inator" to ruin Rogers's meeting with a visiting dignitary from England./ Craziness has ensued in Danville and no one has any idea what’s going on. The wackiness unfolds when Phineas and Ferb create Cheese-topia, Doofenshmirtz makes Perry his butler with his Butler-inator and Carl is trapped by Doof’s while in a squirrel costume.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
"فادي اللاتيني" / "لوتسا لاتكيس"
يبتكر "فارس" و"فادي" لغة خاصة بهما وتدعى "فادي اللاتينية". لسوء حظ "سندس"، تستيقظ على رسالة غامضة وتجد الجميع يتحدث لغة لا تفهمها. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" يقرر استخدام الدعاية كجهاز جديد، معتقدًا أنه سينجح لأن الناس سيصدقون ما يقرأون. / حينما تختفي كل البطاطا من "دانفيل"، "فارس" و"فادي" يقرران استنساخ بعض البطاطا من آخر قطعة بطاطا عند "فؤاد" لكي يمكنوا جدة "جميلة" من إعداد رقائق البطاطا في مهرجان "دانفيل للبطاطا". لسوء الحظ، يختلط حمض "فؤاد" النووي بالبطاطا صانعًا كائنات البطاطا والتي تملأ البلدة. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" يخطط لاستخدام جهازه الأخير، والذي يستمد طاقته من البطاطا، لاستدعاء جيش "سبارتا" وقيادتهم للسيطرة على البلدة. Ferb Latin/ Lotsa Latkes
Phineas and Ferb create their own language, Ferb Latin, which quickly catches on. Unfortunately for Candace, she awakes from a massage puzzled to find everyone else speaking a language she doesn't understand. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz decides to use propaganda as his new "-inator," believing that it will work since people will believe anything they read./ When all the potatoes in Danville go missing, Phineas and Ferb decide to clone some using Buford's last potato chip so that Isabella's Nana can make latkes for the Latke Festival at the Danville Senior Lodge. Unfortunately, Buford's DNA also merges with the potatoes, creating mischievous Potato Gremlins all over town. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz's plans on using his latest "-inator," a potato-powered "Historical Army Retrieve-inator," to summon the Spartan army and command them to take over the Tri-State Area.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
يا له من تمساح / تلفاز "فادي"
يبتكر "فارس" و"فادي" مسلسلات وإعلانات خاصة بهما والتي تتضمن "بخيت" بلعب دور الطبيب النينجا، وبرنامج منوعات والذي فيه رأس الطفل الضخمة و"كليمبالون" و"فؤاد" يلعب دور طباخ والكثير من ذلك. / حينما يكتشف الأخوان أن "كريكي التمساح" أصبح مفقودًا، يذهبان للبحث عنه وإعادته إلى الديار في محمية البلدة. في هذه الأثناء، "إيرفينغ" يكشف سجل صور اختراعات "فارس" و"فادي" لـ"سندس"، والذي يجعلها سعيدة، وحينما يكون "اللواء منير" بعيدًا عن المنظمة، "راي ليوتا"، ضيف شرف، يحل محله ليعطي "بيري" مهمته. أيضًا، "أبو الأشرار" يخطط لإحراج أخيه باستخدام جهاز تبديل الدجاج لاستبدال جائزة العمدة بأقرب دجاجة. What a Croc!/ Ferb TV
Phineas and Ferb create their own TV shows and commercials that include Baljeet starring as a ninja doctor, a variety show featuring the Giant Floating Baby Head and Klimpaloon, as well as Buford as a temperamental celebrity chef, and much more./ When the boys learn that the famous Crikey the Crocodile, has gone missing, they set out to find and return him to his home at the Danville Nature Preserve. Meanwhile, to Candace's amazement, Irving reveals his digital scrapbook compilation of all of Phineas and Ferb’s wild creations, and while Monogram is away from the agency, guest star Ray Liotta fills in to give Perry his mission. Also, Dr. Doofenshmirtz plans to embarrass his brother by using his 'Chicken-Replace-Inator' to replace Roger’s mayoral award with the nearest chicken.

programme.title: هامستر وغريتل الموسم الثاني - Hamster & Gretel: Season 2
programme.desc:

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
تسليم القدر / فلنرتد
يكتشف "بول" عامل التوصيل أن عمله له معنى أكبر لإنقاذ "دانفيل" حينما يذهب إلى منزل "فارس" و"فادي" وشركة "أبو الأشرار" الشريرة" ومنظمة "بلا برودة". في هذه الحلقة الخاصة نشاهدها من خلال منظوره الشخصي. فريق موسيقى الروك "لاف هاندل" يعود للعب الدور في أداء موسيقي. / مستوحى من جهاز "فادي" ضد الجاذبية، "فارس" يعتقد بأنه من الممتع إيقاف كل منطات بلدة "دانفيل". لسوء الحظ لـ"سندس"، تُصعق بجهاز ضد الجاذبية وينتهي بها المطاف عائمة في سقف المنزل أمام عائلة "سامي". في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" لديه خلطة شريرة والتي تتضمن جهاز إخبار الحقيقة مستضيفًا "آب لينكن" الصادق. Delivery of Destiny/ Let's Bounce
Paul the Delivery Man discovers his job has a higher calling to save Danville as he makes stops at Phineas and Ferb's house, Doofenshmirtz Evil, Inc. and the OWCA in a special episode seen through his eyes. The rock band Love Handel reprises their role for some musical accompaniment./ Inspired by Ferb's personal anti-gravity device, Phineas thinks it would be fun to suspend trampolines all over Danville. Unfortunately for Candace, she also gets zapped by the anti-gravity device and ends up trying to maintain her composure while floating across the dining room floor in front of Jeremy’s family. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz has a recipe for evil that involves his Tell-the-Truth-Inator featuring honest Abe Lincoln.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
أهدأ يوم / انفصال أخوية
بعد أن طلبت الأم من الأولاد الهدوء لكي تتحضر من أجل اختبار الحياكة، "فارس" و"فادي" يصممان ملابس نينجا والتي تجعل من يرتديها مخفيًا عن الناس. في هذه الأثناء، "سندس" تصبح محبطة لأنها لا يمكنها إيجاد الولدين والنيل منهما. في الجهة الأخرى من البلدة، "أبو الأشرار" يخترع جهاز الوسامة. / بعد أن أعلن "بخيت" بأنه لم يعد مهووس "فؤاد"، فيقبل "فؤاد" عرض "أبو الأشرار" في السيطرة على البلدة. الشراكة الجديدة تسبب مشكلة لـ"بيري" حيث أنه لا يمكن كشف نفسه بكونه العميل السري لـ"أبو الأشرار" من دون رؤية "فؤاد" له. في هذه الأثناء، في منزل "فلين فليتشر"، "بخيت" يصبح سعيدًا لأنه سيعيش حياته حرًا. بعد هذه الطاقة الجديدة، يطلب من الولدين أن يساعداه في تسلق جبل "دانفيل. Quietest Day Ever/ Bully Bromance Breakup
After Mom asks the kids to keep quiet while she prepares for her online knitting test, Phineas and Ferb create ninja outfits designed to hide the wearer from anyone who is not wearing them. Meanwhile, Candace becomes increasingly frustrated after she can’t find the boys and bust them. Across town, Dr. Doofenshmirtz invents the De-Handsome-Inator./ After Baljeet announces that he is no longer Buford's nerd, a heartbroken Buford accepts Dr. Doofenshmirtz's proposal to help win over the Tri-State Area. The new partnership causes a problem for Perry since he can't reveal himself as Agent P to Doofenshmirtz without Buford seeing him. Meanwhile, over at the Flynn-Fletcher house, Baljeet is thrilled with the freedom to live his own life. With all his new-found energy, he enlists the boys to help him climb Danville Mountain.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
واجب "دونكيلبيري" / "بوفورد" السري
حينما ينفد التوت من الأم من أجل تحضير فطيرة التوت، الولدان يحاولان إيجاد التوت لها. في هذه الأثناء، "بيري" و"أبو الأشرار" يصبحان في المحيط بعد عودة "أبو الأشرار" إلى الديار لتجديد رخصة قيادته. في "دانفيل"، "سندس تقتنع بأنها اكتشفت الإجابة لمشكلة النيل من أخويها. / "جوسيت" و"كوليت"، فتاتا "فايرسايد" من "فرنسا" تساعدان "جميلة" في الإمساك بالدب البري، أحد أخطر المخلوقات. خطة "فؤاد" بارتداء زي الدب تفشل حينما يكشف أحد هويات فتيات "فايرسايد". في كوخ جديهما، "فارس" و"فادي" يخترعان رشاشًا مذهلًا. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" يكره المعجنات المملحة والذي يجعله يخترع جهاز إعادة المعجنات الملتوية إلى طبيعتها الغير ملتوية. Doonkelberry Imperative, The/ Buford Confidential
When Mom is out of Doonkelberries for her famous Doonkelberry pie, the boys set out to find some for her. Meanwhile, Perry and Dr. Doofenshmirtz find themselves across the ocean as Doofenshmirtz returns home to renew his Druelselsteinian driver’s license. Back in Danville, Candace is convinced she has discovered the answer to her busting problem./ Josette and Colette, the visiting Fireside Girls from France, help Isabella capture the American Grizzly Bear, one of the world's most dangerous creatures. Buford's plan to jokingly dress up as the bear backfires when he discovers the identity of one of the French Fireside Girls, throwing him off his game. Back at their grandparents' cabin, Phineas and Ferb create the most amazing "run-through-the-sprinkler" experience. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz's loathing of pretzels drives him to create the "De-Twist-Inator" to untwist every pretzel in Danville.

programme.title: ميراكيلوس: الدعسوقة والقط الأسود - Miraculous Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir: Season 6
programme.desc:
ميراكيلوس: الدعسوقة والقط الأسود
في عالمٍ حيث تتداخل الأسرار مع المشاعر، يقترب "مارينت" و"أدريان" من بعضهما أكثر من أي وقتٍ مضى. ومع ذلك، لا يزال كلٌ منهما يخفي عن الآخر هويته البطولية. لكن "مارينت" تحمل سرًا أشد وطأة؛ فهي تعلم أن والد "أدريان" لم يكن سوى شرير خارق سابق! وفي الوقت نفسه، تجد الدعسوقة والقط الأسود نفسيهما في مواجهة عدو غامض ومراوغ، يسعى بكل دهاء لسرقة "الميراكيلوس" وإغراق باريس في دوامة من الفوضى. وبينما تنطلق المغامرات، يقف أبطالنا جنبًا إلى جنب مع زملائهم في المدرسة وفريق من الأبطال الخارقين الجدد، ليواجهوا عامًا دراسيًا عاصفًا، مليئًا بالمفاجآت والمشاعر الجارفة وكشف الأسرار التي ستغير كل شيء. Mister Agreste
Marinette finds it increasingly difficult to keep a secret from Adrien…and the arrival of a supervillain who looks just like her old enemy won’t help!

programme.title: Miraculous Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir
programme.desc:
Intuition
Ladybug has lost the Miracle Box and the kwamis. She is left with only her Miraculous, and Cat Noir his. Shadow Moth, who now goes by the name of Monarch, has never been so close to victory. He can now give Miraculous powers to his akumatized people to create ultra-powerful super villains. But our heroes, working together as a duo again, will prove to be more united and closer than ever. This new trial will deeply mark their relationship and their private lives. Nothing will ever be the same. Intuition

Goofy’s Grandma: Mickey helps Goofy by letting his Grandma stay at his house, but soon finds that she’s not the sweet old lady she appears to be.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
الهروب من برج "فارس" / بقايا خلد الماء
يقرر "فادي" و"فارس" صنع برج يتحكم فيه حاسوب والذي سيحاصرهما في الداخل، ويجعلهما يكتشفان عالم الهروب. إنهما يحظيان بالمتعة حتى يصبح الحاسوب عاقلًا ويخرج عن السيطرة. في هذه الأثناء "أبو الأشرار" يخترع جهاز الوقاحة لإفساد مقابلة "روجر" مع شخصية مرموقة من "إنكلترا". / يعم الجنون بلدة "دانفيل" ولا أحد يدري ماذا يحدث. تحدث السخافة حينما "فارس" و"فادي" يخترعان جهازًا جديدًا. يجعل "أبو الأشرار" من "بيري" كبير الخدم باستخدام جهاز كبير الخدم، و"كارل" يصبح محبوسًا في زيّ السنجاب. Escape from Phineas Tower/The Remains of the Platypus
When Phineas and Ferb are inspired by an antique escape chamber Dad acquires, they decide to build a computer-controlled tower that will trap them inside and allow them to explore the world of escapement. They have fun breaking out of all the traps until the tower becomes self-aware and goes beyond what it was programmed to do. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz invents a "rude-inator" to ruin Rogers's meeting with a visiting dignitary from England./ Craziness has ensued in Danville and no one has any idea what’s going on. The wackiness unfolds when Phineas and Ferb create Cheese-topia, Doofenshmirtz makes Perry his butler with his Butler-inator and Carl is trapped by Doof’s while in a squirrel costume.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
"فادي اللاتيني" / "لوتسا لاتكيس"
يبتكر "فارس" و"فادي" لغة خاصة بهما وتدعى "فادي اللاتينية". لسوء حظ "سندس"، تستيقظ على رسالة غامضة وتجد الجميع يتحدث لغة لا تفهمها. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" يقرر استخدام الدعاية كجهاز جديد، معتقدًا أنه سينجح لأن الناس سيصدقون ما يقرأون. / حينما تختفي كل البطاطا من "دانفيل"، "فارس" و"فادي" يقرران استنساخ بعض البطاطا من آخر قطعة بطاطا عند "فؤاد" لكي يمكنوا جدة "جميلة" من إعداد رقائق البطاطا في مهرجان "دانفيل للبطاطا". لسوء الحظ، يختلط حمض "فؤاد" النووي بالبطاطا صانعًا كائنات البطاطا والتي تملأ البلدة. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" يخطط لاستخدام جهازه الأخير، والذي يستمد طاقته من البطاطا، لاستدعاء جيش "سبارتا" وقيادتهم للسيطرة على البلدة. Ferb Latin/ Lotsa Latkes
Phineas and Ferb create their own language, Ferb Latin, which quickly catches on. Unfortunately for Candace, she awakes from a massage puzzled to find everyone else speaking a language she doesn't understand. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz decides to use propaganda as his new "-inator," believing that it will work since people will believe anything they read./ When all the potatoes in Danville go missing, Phineas and Ferb decide to clone some using Buford's last potato chip so that Isabella's Nana can make latkes for the Latke Festival at the Danville Senior Lodge. Unfortunately, Buford's DNA also merges with the potatoes, creating mischievous Potato Gremlins all over town. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz's plans on using his latest "-inator," a potato-powered "Historical Army Retrieve-inator," to summon the Spartan army and command them to take over the Tri-State Area.

Mom's in the House/ Minor Monogram
When Phineas and Ferb can’t find Perry they decide to create the Perrytronic 3000, a mechanical structure that can assume any form. Of course, being aware of the boys’ every move, Candace decides to take a different tactic on her busting approach by using a new technique that keeps Phineas and Ferb from finishing their Perry project. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz invents a Duplicator-Inator so that he can duplicate his own head and make himself twice as smart.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
سيف "فادي" الجزء الأول والثاني
أثناء عصر القرون الوسطى، "فارس" و"فادي" يسعيان لإيجاد السيف الأسطوري "سيف فادي"، لكي يهزمان الساحر الشرير "ميليفيشميرتز". Excaliferb (Parts 1 and 2)
During medieval times, Phineas and Ferb (or, Ferb-a-lot) set off on an epic quest to find the legendary sword, Excaliferb, so they can defeat the evil sorcerer, Millifishmirtz.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
وحش من "آي دي" / عمالقة
بعد فقدان الهدية التي صنعها "سامي" لها، "سندس" تحاول إعادة صنعها مجددًا قبل أن يدرك "سامي" أنها مفقودة. لسوء الحظ، "سندس" لا تذكر كيف تبدو الهدية لذلك تستعين بآلة عقل "فارس" و"فادي" للدخول إلى عقلها اللا واعي وإعادة ذاكرتها. في هذه الأثناء، خطة "أبو الأشرار" هي استخدام جهاز الملابس الداخلية للسيطرة على البلدة، حيث أن الجميع خائف من أن يراه الناس بملابسه الداخلية. / يعتقد "فارس" و"فادي" أنه من الممتع أن يكونا جزءًا من مجتمع النمل، فيصنعان ويخترقان مزرعة نمل ضخمة تحتوي على نمل ضخم. تعتقد "سندس" بأن الولدين سيبتكران شيئًا لذلك تدخل إلى مزرعة النمل وتلاحقهما. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" يشعر بالتعب بعد أكل ديك رومي، لذلك يقرر بناء جهاز ديك رومي والذي سيؤدي إلى تفشي النوم في "دانفيل" بتحويل الأشياء إلى ديوك رومية لا يمكن مقاومتها. Monster from the Id/ Gi-Ants
After losing a gift that Jeremy made for her, Candace is determined to recreate it before Jeremy realizes it’s missing. Unfortunately, Candace can’t remember what it looks like, so she enlists the Phineas and Ferb to use their mind machine to enter into her subconscious and recapture the memory. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz’s evil plan is to use his Underwear-Inator to take over the Tri-State Area, since everyone's greatest fear is being caught in public in their underwear. / Thinking it would be cool to be part of an ant society, Phineas and Ferb create and infiltrate the Antius Maximus, a massive ant farm filled with giant ants. Suspecting that the boys are up to something, Candace accidentally drenches herself in the ant pheromones and follows them inside. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz feels tired and lethargic after eating turkey and decides to create a Turkey-Inator that will create a sleeping epidemic in Danville by turning things into giant irresistible turkeys.

مفاجأة المشي أثناء النوم / خيال علمي "باي فلاي"
خطة "سندس" لمقابلة "سامي" تفشل حينما يصبح مهتمًا بلعب لعبة "فارس" و"فادي" الجديدة وهي الكرة الطائرة النفاثة. في هذه الأثناء، يكتشف "أبو الأشرار" أنه يخترع أجهزته خلال نومه، فيقرر أن يعود إلى أحلامه لمعرفة ماذا يحدث. / "فارس" و"فادي" يبتكران صحنًا طائرًا للمساعدة في حل لغز طفح المحاصيل. في هذه الأثناء، "سندس" تقرر أخذ يوم لنفسها، وفي الجهة المقابلة من البلدة، "أبو الأشرار" ينافس مطعم بيتزا عن طريق قاعدة "37 دقيقة أو تصبح البيتزا مجانية" باستخدام جهاز العجين لجعل العجين يلتصق بالسقف. Sleepwalk Surprise/ Sci-Fi Pie Fly
Candace's plans to hang out with Jeremy are derailed, after he becomes interested in playing Phineas and Ferb's newest game, jet pack volleyball. Meanwhile, when Dr. Doofenshmirtz discovers he invents "-inators" in his sleep, he decides to go back into his dreams to find out what is happening./ Phineas and Ferb create their own flying saucer to help solve the mystery of a recent rash of crop circles. Meanwhile, Candace tries to give up her tattling habit by taking a "me" day, and across town, Dr. Doofenshmirtz challenges the local pizzeria's "37 Minutes or it's Free" rule by using his "dough-blow-inator" to generate a powerful current of air to hold the pizza dough aloft indefinitely.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
ميبليس في "سياتل"
يعود "ميب" لينقذ "فارس" و"فادي" من عدوهما "ميتش"، والذي مهمته الحقيقية هي السيطرة على الفضائيين، والذي يضع عالم "ميب" في خطر. جهاز الولدين الباحث عن الكائنات اللطيفة يذهب بالجماعة إلى "سياتل" لإنقاذ العالم. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" يقرر زيارة عدوه السابق، "بيتر الباندا"، لكن حينما يظهر العميل السري فيجد "أبو الأشرار" نفسه بحاجة إلى توضيح موقفه. Meapless in Seattle (Part 1 and 2)
Meap returns to save Phineas and Ferb from his nemesis Mitch, whose real mission is to take control of all of alien-kind, putting Meap's world in danger. The boys' 'cute-tracker' leads the gang to Seattle and an adventure to save the universe. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz decides to revisit his former nemesis, Peter the Panda, but when Agent P shows up, Dr. Doofenshmirtz finds that he has some explaining to do.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
جاذب الأم / "كرانيوس مكسيموس"
حينما يطلب الأخوان من "سندس" ماذا يمكنهما فعله لليوم، تطلب منهما بمكر اختراع جهاز لجذب أمهم لكي تنال من أخويها. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" اخترع جهاز "بكاء الأطفال" والذي هو مصمم لإفساد صورة أخيه. / حينما يصبح "بخيت" قلقًا بشأن فقدان عقله، الولدان يخترعان قبعة لتنشيط المخ لمساعدته. لكن حينما تخالف القبعة التوقعات وتجعل "بخيت" أكثر ذكاءً، فذلك يجعله يرى كل شخص أقل منه ويصبح خطرًا على المجتمع. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" يخطط لاستخدام جهاز البحث عن المفاتيح لجمع كل مفاتيح "دانفيل" آملًا أن يجد مفتاح المدينة الأصلي. Mom Attractor, The/ Cranius Maximus
When the boys ask Candace to decide what they should do for the day, she slyly asks them to invent a device to attract their Mom so that she can finally bust her brothers. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz has invented a "Baby-Cry-Inator" designed to tarnish his goodie-two-shoes brother's image with the electorate./ When Baljeet becomes concerned that he is losing his mental edge, the boys invent a cerebral stimulatory hat, or "Brain booster," to help him. But when the hat exceeds expectations and makes Baljeet exponentially smarter, he suddenly views everyone else as beneath him and becomes a threat to civilization. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz plans to use his "Key-Find-Inator" to collect all the keys in Danville in hopes that it will lead to the Key to the City.

يبتكر "فارس" و"فادي" مسلسلات وإعلانات خاصة بهما والتي تتضمن "بخيت" بلعب دور الطبيب النينجا، وبرنامج منوعات والذي فيه رأس الطفل الضخمة و"كليمبالون" و"فؤاد" يلعب دور طباخ والكثير من ذلك. / حينما يكتشف الأخوان أن "كريكي التمساح" أصبح مفقودًا، يذهبان للبحث عنه وإعادته إلى الديار في محمية البلدة. في هذه الأثناء، "إيرفينغ" يكشف سجل صور اختراعات "فارس" و"فادي" لـ"سندس"، والذي يجعلها سعيدة، وحينما يكون "اللواء منير" بعيدًا عن المنظمة، "راي ليوتا"، ضيف شرف، يحل محله ليعطي "بيري" مهمته. أيضًا، "أبو الأشرار" يخطط لإحراج أخيه باستخدام جهاز تبديل الدجاج لاستبدال جائزة العمدة بأقرب دجاجة. What a Croc!/ Ferb TV
Phineas and Ferb create their own TV shows and commercials that include Baljeet starring as a ninja doctor, a variety show featuring the Giant Floating Baby Head and Klimpaloon, as well as Buford as a temperamental celebrity chef, and much more./ When the boys learn that the famous Crikey the Crocodile, has gone missing, they set out to find and return him to his home at the Danville Nature Preserve. Meanwhile, to Candace's amazement, Irving reveals his digital scrapbook compilation of all of Phineas and Ferb’s wild creations, and while Monogram is away from the agency, guest star Ray Liotta fills in to give Perry his mission. Also, Dr. Doofenshmirtz plans to embarrass his brother by using his 'Chicken-Replace-Inator' to replace Roger’s mayoral award with the nearest chicken.

يفشل "فارس" و"فادي" في إيجاد "بيري" فيقرران صنع جهاز "بيريترونيك 3000"، جهاز ميكانيكي والذي يمكنه التشكل بأي شكل. بالطبع بكونها تعلم كل حركة للولدين، "سندس" تقرر اتخاذ طريقة مختلفة للنيل من أخويها بتعطيل أخويها من إنهاء مشروع "بيري" الجديد. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" يخترع جهاز الاستنساخ لكي يستنسخ عقله ليصبح أكثر ذكاءً. Of course, being aware of the boys’ every move, Candace decides to take a different tactic on her busting approach by using a new technique that keeps Phineas and Ferb from finishing their Perry project. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz invents a Duplicator-Inator so that he can duplicate his own head and make himself twice as smart.

The Chatterleys and Barry try to get ready for a big event. Kiff and the crew run the morning announcements at school and it gets out of control.

programme.title: كيف - Kiff: Season 2

Kiff and the crew learn magic, but end up in over their heads. Helen casts a spell on Kiff and Barry and won't tell them what it is.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
العميل "دووف" / "فارس" و"فادي" ومعبد "جواتشادون"
بعد تحديد مكان قلادة "جواتشدون" واسترجاعها، عالما الآثار "فارس" و"فادي" يذهبان إلى أمريكا الوسطى لمساعدة "جميلة"، التي في ورطة، لإيجاد "معبد جواتشدون" المفقود وأمها المفقودة. رغم ذلك، "أبو الأشرار" لديه خطط أخرى للقلادة، ألا وهي إيقاظ عملاق شرير لمساعدة في القضاء على العالم. Agent Doof/ Phineas and Ferb and the Temple of Juatchadoon
After locating and retrieving the amulet of Juatchdoon, adventuring archeologist duo Ohio (Phineas) Flynn and Rhode Island (Ferb) Fletcher set off to Central America to help Damsel in Distress Isabella find the Lost Temple of Juatchadoon and her missing mother. However, Dr. Doofenshmirtz has other plans for the amulet – to awaken the evil corn colossus to give him the power to destroy the world.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
تسليم القدر / فلنرتد
يكتشف "بول" عامل التوصيل أن عمله له معنى أكبر لإنقاذ "دانفيل" حينما يذهب إلى منزل "فارس" و"فادي" وشركة "أبو الأشرار" الشريرة" ومنظمة "بلا برودة". في هذه الحلقة الخاصة نشاهدها من خلال منظوره الشخصي. فريق موسيقى الروك "لاف هاندل" يعود للعب الدور في أداء موسيقي. / مستوحى من جهاز "فادي" ضد الجاذبية، "فارس" يعتقد بأنه من الممتع إيقاف كل منطات بلدة "دانفيل". لسوء الحظ لـ"سندس"، تُصعق بجهاز ضد الجاذبية وينتهي بها المطاف عائمة في سقف المنزل أمام عائلة "سامي". في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" لديه خلطة شريرة والتي تتضمن جهاز إخبار الحقيقة مستضيفًا "آب لينكن" الصادق. Delivery of Destiny/ Let's Bounce
Paul the Delivery Man discovers his job has a higher calling to save Danville as he makes stops at Phineas and Ferb's house, Doofenshmirtz Evil, Inc. and the OWCA in a special episode seen through his eyes. The rock band Love Handel reprises their role for some musical accompaniment./ Inspired by Ferb's personal anti-gravity device, Phineas thinks it would be fun to suspend trampolines all over Danville. Unfortunately for Candace, she also gets zapped by the anti-gravity device and ends up trying to maintain her composure while floating across the dining room floor in front of Jeremy’s family. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz has a recipe for evil that involves his Tell-the-Truth-Inator featuring honest Abe Lincoln.

Gramma needs help with a winter tradition but worries her family won’t come through. Feeling overshadowed by Jade, Gloria starts a suggestion box at the cafe to dial Jade back.

Dr. Doof's latest inator accidentally turns all the people of Danville into contagious Doof-zombies. Perry and the kids try to save their loved ones and their home town.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
حرب نجوم "فارس" و"فادي"
يعيش "فارس" و"فادي" بالقرب من "لوك سكاي واكر" على كوكب "تاتوين"، حينما "ر2د2" ونجم الموت يخططان للسقوط في مركبتهما. حينما يكون مصير المجرة على عاتقهم، يقرروا استئجار الطيارة "إليزابيث" وهي عدوة "هان سولو"، للمساعدة في إرجاع المخططات إلى جنود التمرد. تصبح الأمور معقدة حينما "سندس" الجندية تنوي النيل من المترمدين ومطاردتهم عبر المجرة لاستعادة مخططات نجم الموت. في هذه الأثناء، تحدث الفوضى في نجم الموت حينما "بيري" يصبح محبوسًا في الكاربون والذي يساعد "أبو الأشرار" في بناء جهاز "السيث". الأمور تصبح أسوأ حينما "فادي" يصبح في مرمى الخطر لجهاز "السيث"، محولًا إياه إلى "سيث" مهاجمًا أخيه. Phineas and Ferb Star Wars (Part 1)
Phineas and Ferb are living just one moisture farm over from Luke Skywalker on the planet of Tatooine when R2-D2 and the Death Star plans inadvertently fall into their speeder. With the fate of the galaxy thrust upon their shoulders, they hire pilot Isabella, Han Solo's rival, to help them return the plans to the Rebel Alliance. Complicating matters, low-ranking Stormtrooper Candace is intent on busting the Rebels and chases them across the galaxy in hopes of retrieving the Death Star plans. Meanwhile, intergalactic chaos erupts on the Death Star when Perry the Rebelpus is trapped in carbonite while trying to stop Darthenshmirtz from using his new "Sith-inator." The saga takes a turn for the worse when Ferb is accidentally caught in the crossfire of the "Sith-inator," changing him into a full-fledged Sith and leading to an epic first-time battle between the brothers.

يتابع المسلسل كيف، أنثى سنجاب متفائلة، يقودها تعطشها للحياة إلى عيش مغامرات عديدة في بلدتها، إلى جانب باري، صديقها المفضل الرائع. تدور الأحداث في بلدة تتعايش فيها الحيوانات والمخلوقات السحرية، ويتخطى الثنائي المدرسة والعلاقات ومجتمعها الذي غالباً ما يتسم بالغرابة. Club Book

Tilly and Cricket wrestle with decision-making at a truck stop between Big City and the country. Tilly rises through the ranks as a Big City jingle writer.

Bill discovers his favorite comedian, Fred the Farmer, may not be who he claims to be. Tilly defends Cricket at a family trial after he's accused of stealing an entire cake.

programme.desc:

However, Dr. Doofenshmirtz has other plans for the amulet – to awaken the evil corn colossus to give him the power to destroy the world.

programme.desc:

The rock band Love Handel reprises their role for some musical accompaniment./ Inspired by Ferb's personal anti-gravity device, Phineas thinks it would be fun to suspend trampolines all over Danville. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz has a recipe for evil that involves his Tell-the-Truth-Inator featuring honest Abe Lincoln.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
أهدأ يوم / انفصال أخوية
بعد أن طلبت الأم من الأولاد الهدوء لكي تتحضر من أجل اختبار الحياكة، "فارس" و"فادي" يصممان ملابس نينجا والتي تجعل من يرتديها مخفيًا عن الناس. في هذه الأثناء، "سندس" تصبح محبطة لأنها لا يمكنها إيجاد الولدين والنيل منهما. في الجهة الأخرى من البلدة، "أبو الأشرار" يخترع جهاز الوسامة. / بعد أن أعلن "بخيت" بأنه لم يعد مهووس "فؤاد"، فيقبل "فؤاد" عرض "أبو الأشرار" في السيطرة على البلدة. الشراكة الجديدة تسبب مشكلة لـ"بيري" حيث أنه لا يمكن كشف نفسه بكونه العميل السري لـ"أبو الأشرار" من دون رؤية "فؤاد" له. في هذه الأثناء، في منزل "فلين فليتشر"، "بخيت" يصبح سعيدًا لأنه سيعيش حياته حرًا. بعد هذه الطاقة الجديدة، يطلب من الولدين أن يساعداه في تسلق جبل "دانفيل. Quietest Day Ever/ Bully Bromance Breakup
After Mom asks the kids to keep quiet while she prepares for her online knitting test, Phineas and Ferb create ninja outfits designed to hide the wearer from anyone who is not wearing them. Meanwhile, Candace becomes increasingly frustrated after she can’t find the boys and bust them. Across town, Dr. Doofenshmirtz invents the De-Handsome-Inator./ After Baljeet announces that he is no longer Buford's nerd, a heartbroken Buford accepts Dr. Doofenshmirtz's proposal to help win over the Tri-State Area. The new partnership causes a problem for Perry since he can't reveal himself as Agent P to Doofenshmirtz without Buford seeing him. Meanwhile, over at the Flynn-Fletcher house, Baljeet is thrilled with the freedom to live his own life. With all his new-found energy, he enlists the boys to help him climb Danville Mountain.

The family embarks on a trip to Africa, but when Perry receives an urgent call from Major Monogram, he has to feign illness in order to save the day. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz plans to distract Agent P with a phony "inator," so that he can use his "Ultimate Evil-inator" ray on Major Monogram and take over OWCA. However, after Carl is inadvertently hit, Dr. Doofenshmirtz's plan takes an unexpected turn, and Agent P disappears after being struck by one of the rays.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
أين "بيري"؟ الجزء الثاني
مصير العميل السري يظهر أخيرًا في الحلقة الأخيرة المقسومة على جزئين، والتي تركت "فارس" و"فادي" والمجموعة عالقين في ممر ضيق، و"سندس" تتلقى اتصالًا من "سامي" والذي يجعل علاقتهما معلقة. الآن، العميل السري مختفٍ، "اللواء منير" و"أبو الأشرار" يواجهان "كارل" الشرير والذي يسيطر على روبوتات عائلة "فلين فليتشر" للسيطرة على منظمة "بلا برودة"، في إحدى أكبر المعارك على الإطلاق. Where's Perry? (Part II) (Part 2 of 2)
Agent P's fate is finally revealed in the action-packed finale of the two-part television special that left Phineas, Ferb and the gang hanging… literally off an unchartered gorge and Candace frantic over a phone call with Jeremy that left their relationship status in limbo. Now, with Agent P nowhere in sight, Dr. Doofenshmirtz and Major Monogram square off against evil Carl who controls a set of Flynn-Fletcher robots to take over the OWCA, in one of the biggest battles yet.

Blackout!/ What'd I Miss?
Phineas and Ferb seize the opportunity to make the most of Danville's electricity blackout while Dr. Doofenshmirtz tries to use pity to his advantage./ Phineas and the gang introduce Ferb and Perry to their newest project – training domesticated squirrels to live in the wild. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz aims to do a better job of seeing through his evil plans now that Agent P is back.

في عالمٍ حيث تتداخل الأسرار مع المشاعر، يقترب "مارينت" و"أدريان" من بعضهما أكثر من أي وقتٍ مضى. ومع ذلك، لا يزال كلٌ منهما يخفي عن الآخر هويته البطولية. لكن "مارينت" تحمل سرًا أشد وطأة؛ فهي تعلم أن والد "أدريان" لم يكن سوى شرير خارق سابق! وفي الوقت نفسه، تجد الدعسوقة والقط الأسود نفسيهما في مواجهة عدو غامض ومراوغ، يسعى بكل دهاء لسرقة "الميراكيلوس" وإغراق باريس في دوامة من الفوضى. وبينما تنطلق المغامرات، يقف أبطالنا جنبًا إلى جنب مع زملائهم في المدرسة وفريق من الأبطال الخارقين الجدد، ليواجهوا عامًا دراسيًا عاصفًا، مليئًا بالمفاجآت والمشاعر الجارفة وكشف الأسرار التي ستغير كل شيء. programme.desc:
الهروب من برج "فارس" / بقايا خلد الماء
يقرر "فادي" و"فارس" صنع برج يتحكم فيه حاسوب والذي سيحاصرهما في الداخل، ويجعلهما يكتشفان عالم الهروب. إنهما يحظيان بالمتعة حتى يصبح الحاسوب عاقلًا ويخرج عن السيطرة. في هذه الأثناء "أبو الأشرار" يخترع جهاز الوقاحة لإفساد مقابلة "روجر" مع شخصية مرموقة من "إنكلترا". / يعم الجنون بلدة "دانفيل" ولا أحد يدري ماذا يحدث. تحدث السخافة حينما "فارس" و"فادي" يخترعان جهازًا جديدًا. يجعل "أبو الأشرار" من "بيري" كبير الخدم باستخدام جهاز كبير الخدم، و"كارل" يصبح محبوسًا في زيّ السنجاب. Escape from Phineas Tower/The Remains of the Platypus
When Phineas and Ferb are inspired by an antique escape chamber Dad acquires, they decide to build a computer-controlled tower that will trap them inside and allow them to explore the world of escapement. They have fun breaking out of all the traps until the tower becomes self-aware and goes beyond what it was programmed to do. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz invents a "rude-inator" to ruin Rogers's meeting with a visiting dignitary from England./ Craziness has ensued in Danville and no one has any idea what’s going on. The wackiness unfolds when Phineas and Ferb create Cheese-topia, Doofenshmirtz makes Perry his butler with his Butler-inator and Carl is trapped by Doof’s while in a squirrel costume.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
"فادي اللاتيني" / "لوتسا لاتكيس"
يبتكر "فارس" و"فادي" لغة خاصة بهما وتدعى "فادي اللاتينية". لسوء حظ "سندس"، تستيقظ على رسالة غامضة وتجد الجميع يتحدث لغة لا تفهمها. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" يقرر استخدام الدعاية كجهاز جديد، معتقدًا أنه سينجح لأن الناس سيصدقون ما يقرأون. / حينما تختفي كل البطاطا من "دانفيل"، "فارس" و"فادي" يقرران استنساخ بعض البطاطا من آخر قطعة بطاطا عند "فؤاد" لكي يمكنوا جدة "جميلة" من إعداد رقائق البطاطا في مهرجان "دانفيل للبطاطا". لسوء الحظ، يختلط حمض "فؤاد" النووي بالبطاطا صانعًا كائنات البطاطا والتي تملأ البلدة. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" يخطط لاستخدام جهازه الأخير، والذي يستمد طاقته من البطاطا، لاستدعاء جيش "سبارتا" وقيادتهم للسيطرة على البلدة. Ferb Latin/ Lotsa Latkes
Phineas and Ferb create their own language, Ferb Latin, which quickly catches on. Unfortunately for Candace, she awakes from a massage puzzled to find everyone else speaking a language she doesn't understand. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz decides to use propaganda as his new "-inator," believing that it will work since people will believe anything they read./ When all the potatoes in Danville go missing, Phineas and Ferb decide to clone some using Buford's last potato chip so that Isabella's Nana can make latkes for the Latke Festival at the Danville Senior Lodge. Unfortunately, Buford's DNA also merges with the potatoes, creating mischievous Potato Gremlins all over town. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz's plans on using his latest "-inator," a potato-powered "Historical Army Retrieve-inator," to summon the Spartan army and command them to take over the Tri-State Area.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
حرب نجوم "فارس" و"فادي"
يعيش "فارس" و"فادي" بالقرب من "لوك سكاي واكر" على كوكب "تاتوين"، حينما "ر2د2" ونجم الموت يخططان للسقوط في مركبتهما. حينما يكون مصير المجرة على عاتقهم، يقرروا استئجار الطيارة "إليزابيث" وهي عدوة "هان سولو"، للمساعدة في إرجاع المخططات إلى جنود التمرد. تصبح الأمور معقدة حينما "سندس" الجندية تنوي النيل من المترمدين ومطاردتهم عبر المجرة لاستعادة مخططات نجم الموت. في هذه الأثناء، تحدث الفوضى في نجم الموت حينما "بيري" يصبح محبوسًا في الكاربون والذي يساعد "أبو الأشرار" في بناء جهاز "السيث". الأمور تصبح أسوأ حينما "فادي" يصبح في مرمى الخطر لجهاز "السيث"، محولًا إياه إلى "سيث" مهاجمًا أخيه. Phineas and Ferb Star Wars (Part 1)
Phineas and Ferb are living just one moisture farm over from Luke Skywalker on the planet of Tatooine when R2-D2 and the Death Star plans inadvertently fall into their speeder. With the fate of the galaxy thrust upon their shoulders, they hire pilot Isabella, Han Solo's rival, to help them return the plans to the Rebel Alliance. Complicating matters, low-ranking Stormtrooper Candace is intent on busting the Rebels and chases them across the galaxy in hopes of retrieving the Death Star plans. Meanwhile, intergalactic chaos erupts on the Death Star when Perry the Rebelpus is trapped in carbonite while trying to stop Darthenshmirtz from using his new "Sith-inator." The saga takes a turn for the worse when Ferb is accidentally caught in the crossfire of the "Sith-inator," changing him into a full-fledged Sith and leading to an epic first-time battle between the brothers.

programme.desc:
قبعة / المذكرات المفقودة

Kiff loses a hat that gave Barry a confidence boost, and attempts to recover it; Kiff and Barry try to return a lost journal without exposing its deeply personal entries.

programme.title: فينيس وفيرب - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
عيد ميلاد أمي/ رحلة إلى عالم "سندس"
يوم مليء بالمفاجآت لوالدتهما حين تحاول "سندس" وأخويها إعداد لها أفضل عيد ميلاد على الإطلاق. / حين يأكل كلب"جميلة"، "بينكي"، وشاح فتاة المدفأة، يحاول الأخوان تقديم المساعدة من خلال بناء غواصة منكمشة ودخول أمعاء "بينكي". ولكن تظهر المشاكل عندما ينتهي بهما الأمر دون قصد في أمعاء "سندس" أثناء وجودها في موعد غرامي مع "جيرمي". Mom's Birthday/ Journey to the Center of Candace
The day is full of surprises for Mom when Candace and the boys try to give her the best birthday ever. / When Isabella's dog, Pinky, eats her Fireside Girl’s Sash, the boys try to help by building a shrinking submarine and entering Pinky’s stomach. But complications arise when they accidentally find themselves in Candace's stomach while she's on a date with Jeremy.

programme.title: فينيس وفيرب - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
الفرار هربًا/ أصرخ وأنت تصرخ
أثناء سعي "سندس" لتصبح عارضة أزياء، يقرر "فارس" و"فادي" اقتحام عالم الموضة وإنشاء خط ملابس مناسب بشكل كبير لأزياء فصل الصيف./ بعد استئصال لوزتي حلق "جميلة"، يحاول "فارس" و"فادي" إسعادها عن طريق صنع لها أكبر مثلجات في العالم. لكن خطتهما تفشل حين قام الأخوان عن غير قصد بتغيير المخططات مع دكتور "أبو الأشرار" Run Away Runway/ I Scream, You Scream
During Candace’s quest to become a runway supermodel, Phineas and Ferb decide to take on the fashion world and create a clothing line that completely personifies summer. / After Isabella's tonsils are taken out, Phineas and Ferb try to cheer her up by making her the world's biggest ice cream sundae. But their plan misfires when the boys accidentally switch blueprints with Dr. Doofenshmirtz.

programme.title: فينيس وفيرب - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
عالم الطين/ قصة اللحية السيئة
عند حكاية جد "فارس "و"فادي" عن أسطورة القرصان الغامض المحيط بالبحيرة القديمة بجوار منزلهم، انطلق الأطفال في مغامرة في عرض البحار. وفي هذه الأثناء، ابتلعت "سندس" الطحلب البرتقالي دون قصد وكانت ترى بعض الأشياء الغريبة. كما في "بيري" والدكتور "أبو الأشرار" في خدعهم القديمة. كانت "سندس" خائفة للغاية من تعلم القيادة، لذلك قرر "فارس" و"فادي" مساعدتها في التغلب على مخاوفها من خلال ابتكار أكثر السيارات أمانًا ووقاية "لسندس" للتدرب عليها- شاحنة عملاقة. إذا تمكنت من قيادتها، ستنجح في قيادة أي شيء. ولكن فجأة تحول تدريب "سندس" على الركض في الفناء الخلفي إلى سباق ضخم للشاحنات العملاقة. It's a Mud, Mud, Mud, Mud World/ Ballad of Badbeard, The
When Phineas and Ferb’s Grandpa tells them about a mysterious pirate legend surrounding the old lake by their house, the kids set out on an open seas adventure. Meanwhile Candace has accidentally ingested the “orange moss” and is seeing some weird things. Like Perry and Dr. Doofenschmirtz up to their old tricks. Candace is scared to death to learn how to drive, so Phineas and Ferb decide to help her overcome her fears by creating the safest and most Candace-proof vehicle for her to practice in – a monster truck. If she can drive that, she can drive anything. But suddenly Candace’s “practice run” through the backyard turns into a massive monster truck rally.

programme.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
programme.desc:

programme.desc:
قبلة على الخد
"بلوي" و"بينغو" يريدان امتلاك الأب لأنفسهما حتى يكتشفان أن لديهما بعض العادات السيئة. Smoochy Kiss
Bluey and Bingo want Dad all to themselves until they discover he has some gross habits.

programme.desc:
اجتماع عائلي
عندما اُتهم الأب بـ"العبث" في وجه "بلوي"، تدعو الأم لاجتماع لتسوية الأمر. Family Meeting
When Dad's accused of "fluffing" in Bluey's face, Mum calls a meeting to settle the matter.

programme.title: بلوي - Bluey
programme.desc:
الزيلفون السحري
بلوي وبينغو تكتشفان زيلفونا سحريا لديه القدرة على تجميد الأب في الزمان والمكان. ويمكنهما من نقله إلى أوضاع محرجة مضحكة. لكن هذه الآلة الموسيقية ذات القدرة الكبيرة تجعل من الصعب على بلوي مشاركتها مع بينغو، رغم تهديد الأم بأخذها ومواصلة بلوي التوسل، تتخلى بلوى عن السيطرة عليها على مضض. عندما يؤدي شجارهما إلى استحواذ الأب على الزيلفون وتجميد بلوي تصبح بينغو الأمل الوحيد لها. تتفاهم الصغيرتان وتعملان معاً لاستعادة الزيلفون السحري وتسلبان الأب السيطرة ثانية The Magic Xylophone
Bluey and Bingo fight over a magic xylophone.

programme.title: بلوي - Bluey
programme.desc:
Hospital
Playing ‘Hospital’ leaves Dad in the needle-happy hands of Doctor Bluey as she and Nurse Bingo diagnose his sore tummy. One x-ray (and a few more injections later) and they discover Dad has a cat in his tummy! After singing him to sleep, Bluey gets operating! But the bitey cat just won’t budge. Feeling bad that they were unable to help their patient, Bingo takes another look at the x-ray and discovers the true culprit. Together with Bluey, they inform Dad that the Cat is chasing a mouse! Luring it out with a piece of cheese, Dad gets a clean bill of health - and one more needle for the road! Hospital
Dad gets a very curious x-ray from Nurse Bingo.

programme.title: بلوي - Bluey
programme.desc:
البقاء في الأعلى
الأم تقترح أن تستخدم بلوي آخر بالون لها للعب لعبة البقاء في الأعلى حيث يحاولون إبقاء البالون في الهواء دون أن يلمس الأرض. تكون اللعبة سهلة في البداية، لكن الأب ينقلها إلى مستوى أعلى بكثير، باستخدام مروحة ومنفاخ أوراق الشجر ليحرك البالون في أرجاء المنزل بل ويخرجه من النافذة. بينما يتطاير من فوق السياج، يأتي لاكي وأبوه لينقذا الموقف ويتمكنان من إعادتها إلى باحة منزل بلوي، ثم يتمادى الأب ويبعد البالون بعيدا عن متناول الجميع ليسقط على الأعشاب وينفجر، والآن على الأب دفع الثمن بأن يتظاهر بأنه البالون Keepy Uppy
When Dad joins in a game of Keepy Uppy it becomes serious.

programme.title: بلوي - Bluey
programme.desc:
الأب الآلي
لا تريد بلوي وبينغو ترتيب غرفة اللعب لذا تحضران الأب الآلي ليرتبها. لكن عندما تتمادى بلوي وتخبره أنهما لا تريدان ترتيب غرفة اللعب ثانية، يقرر أن يلقي الطفلتين في سلة المهملات، بمساعدة الأم تنجحان في إيقاف دائرته الكهربائية لكن ذلك يتسبب في عطل كبير به، يتصرف الأب الآلي بطريقة غريبة لكن تنجحان في تشتيت انتباهه بالأم الآلية لفترة كافية لإغلاقه. عندما يعود الأب الآلي إلى العمل. تعطيه بلوي وبينغو تعليمات جديدة بالاسترخاء مع الأم بينما تنظفان الغرفة بنفسيهما Daddy Robot
Problems when Daddy Robot helps Bluey and Bingo tidy up.

programme.title: بلوي - Bluey
programme.desc:
أراضي الظلال
في نزهة خلوية مع الوالدين، تلعب بلوي وسنيكرز وكوكو لعبة أراضي الظلال، وهي لعبة تلزمهم بالسير في المناطق ذات الظلال فقط وتجنب الأعشاب المليئة بالتماسيح وضوء الشمس. لكن تجد بلوي أنه كلما أصبحت اللعبة صعبة، تحاول كوكو أن تسلك طريقا مختصرا ليجدوا أنهن عالقات على جزيرة ظلال مهجورة وعندما تنادي عليهم الأم ليعدن لتناول الشاي والكعك، تستعد كوكو لمخالفة القواعد والخروج من الظل. لكن تصر بلوي على أن يجدن طريقا آخر لأن الألعاب تكون ممتعة أكثر عندما تتبع القواعد. فيركضن تحت سحابة متحركة ويعدن في الوقت المناسب. programme.desc:
إسعاد النحل
بطوط يغضب النحل عندما يهز خليته. يقوم النحل بالزن خلفه، لكن ميكي والأصدقاء يستخدمون المسكدوات لبناء خلية جديدة وتهدئة النحل. Please the Bees
Donald shakes a beehive, upsetting the bees. They buzz after him, but Mickey and pals use Mouseketools to build a new hive and calm them down.
